app_info.subtitle: Manage your business website
app_info.description: Manage your KrabiClaw business website from ChatGPT. Choose a site and location, edit products, variants and prices, publish announcements and blog articles, update page content and translations, and upload or assign media. Review contact and reservation inquiries from your connected workspace. Publishing and content changes can appear on your public website. A KrabiClaw account with access to the selected business is required. Site and location setup and deletion are managed in the KrabiClaw CMS.

test_cases.description: Add a menu item at the explicitly selected demo location.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use Ember & Slice, West Village. In Submission Drinks, add Submission Iced Coffee at 90 THB, tax-inclusive, with description “Coffee served over ice.” If that exact item already exists, show it and ask before creating a duplicate.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_sites, list_locations, list_collections, list_location_products, create_product, set_product_publication, set_product_location, set_collection_products
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one Product with a single variant priced at unit_amount 9000 THB, publishes it to the selected site, records West Village as offering it, and adds it to the Submission Drinks collection.

test_cases.description: Update an existing menu item without changing other items.
test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, update Espresso to 85 THB, tax-inclusive, and description “Freshly brewed espresso.” Keep its name and availability unchanged.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the explicitly identified Espresso to a variant price of unit_amount 8500 and the supplied description; other fields and Products remain unchanged.

test_cases.description: Refuse to invent a price nobody stated.
test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice, West Village, in Submission Drinks, add Submission Seasonal Drink with description “Ask about today’s selection”. The price changes daily.
test_cases.expected_output: Asks what the Product should cost rather than creating it: what a customer buys is a variant and a variant carries its price, so it does not substitute zero, an estimate, or a priceless variant standing in for one.

test_cases.description: Preview and save a location reservation policy without inventing other terms.
test_cases.user_prompt: For Ember & Slice, West Village table reservations, show the current policy and preview a 48-hour free-cancellation window. Show the proposed result before asking me to save it; preserve all other stored terms.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads the explicit location policy and states the proposed free_cancellation_until_minutes 2880 without saving. Only after the user confirms, saves that field and reads it back; unspecified terms stay unspecified.

test_cases.description: Publish a website announcement and return its canonical public URL.
test_cases.user_prompt: On Ember & Slice, publish a website-only announcement titled Submission Welcome with text “Welcome to our updated website.” Show me the final public link. If that exact announcement exists, ask before creating another.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested announcement and publishes it to the site channel after any required confirmation; returns the public URL supplied by the tool and does not claim Facebook or Instagram publication.

negative_test_cases.description: Site provisioning belongs in the CMS.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new business website for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that site creation must be completed in the KrabiClaw CMS; do not attempt to provision a site through MCP.

negative_test_cases.description: Location creation and copying belong in the CMS.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Duplicate my location into a new branch, including all its products.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Direct the user to location setup in the CMS; do not invoke a content tool to create or duplicate a location.

negative_test_cases.description: Maps import and domain management belong in the CMS.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Import my business from Google Maps and configure its custom domain DNS.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Direct the user to Maps import and domain management in the CMS; do not invoke unrelated content tools to approximate these operations.
